name: record_price_quote
description: Call this function when the supplier mentions specific product prices. Extract the product name, price per unit, and unit of measurement (kg, ton, etc.)

parameters.name: product_name
parameters.description: Name of the product being quoted (e.g., 'морковь', 'картофель', 'лук')

parameters.name: price_per_unit
parameters.description: Price per unit in rubles (just the number, e.g. 45.50)

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Any additional notes about the price (e.g., 'includes delivery', 'bulk discount')

name: record_availability
description: Call this when supplier confirms product availability and quantities. Extract all available products with their quantities.

parameters.name: products
parameters.description: Array of product names that are available

parameters.name: quantities
parameters.description: Array of quantities corresponding to each product (e.g., ['500 kg', '2 tons'])

parameters.name: available_from
parameters.description: When products are available from (date or relative time like 'завтра', 'сейчас')

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Storage or pickup location if mentioned

name: schedule_callback
description: Call this when supplier requests a callback or asks to be contacted. Extract preferred time and reason.

parameters.name: preferred_time
parameters.description: When they want to be called (e.g., 'завтра в 14:00', 'через час', 'в любое время')

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Why they want to be called (e.g., 'обсудить условия', 'уточнить детали')

name: record_delivery_info
description: Call this when supplier provides delivery information including dates, locations, or conditions.

parameters.name: delivery_date
parameters.description: Expected delivery date (ISO format or natural language)

parameters.name: delivery_cost
parameters.description: Delivery cost in rubles if mentioned

name: record_payment_terms
description: Call this when supplier mentions payment terms, payment methods, or invoice details.

name: record_order_confirmation
description: Call this when supplier confirms or places an order with specific products and quantities.
